srd_section: Playing the Game / Combat / Making an Attack; Equipment / Weapons and Armor; Rules Glossary / Unarmed Strike
adaptation_notes: Attack bonus is the Strength (Dexterity for ranged, better of the two for Finesse) modifier plus proficiency for a trained weapon category or weapon plus magic bonus; damage adds the same modifier; AC follows unarmored/light/medium/heavy armor. Unarmed strikes are always proficient and deal 1 + Strength with no die to double on a critical hit. Every hit deals at least 1 damage. The symmetric +2/-2 modifier at a 2.5 m elevation difference is an original project rule, not SRD content.

srd_section: Playing the Game / Combat / Making an Attack
adaptation_notes: Generic melee weapon attack; project represents the SRD 5-foot reach as 1.5 m and uses equipment-driven statistics.
Speed is represented in meters and added to the current turn's movement pool.
Suppresses opportunity attacks for the rest of the current turn.
Attack disadvantage is implemented until the owner's next turn; Dexterity-save advantage and loss at Speed 0 are deferred.
Ally-targeted action within 1.5 m; grants the ally's next attack Advantage, with optional target scoping carried by the generic condition instance.
Uses the SRD 2d4+2 healing formula and Bonus Action cost; self-only targeting is retained instead of the SRD adjacent administration.

srd_section: Playing the Game / Combat / Ranged Attacks
adaptation_notes: Generic ranged weapon attack; weapon resources supply range bands and damage.

Bonus Action self-heal using the SRD 1d10 die. There is no level stat, so the SRD "+ Fighter level" bonus is a flat +2 matching a level 1-2 Fighter, and the two uses refill at the next encounter because no rest system exists.

Player chooses Push or Prone; defender uses the better Strength or Dexterity save. Push is adapted to 3 m with navmesh projection, collision blocking, ledge detection, and metric fall damage. Size limits are deferred.
Internal terminal marker; SRD death saves are intentionally not implemented in the single-hero loop.
Runtime condition used to carry the Dodge duration and incoming-attack disadvantage.
Reusable next-attack Advantage condition applied by Help; the condition expires through the next matching attack event.
Implements attack-roll disadvantage; ability-check disadvantage is deferred.

Implements attack modifiers (including Disadvantage on the prone creature's own attacks) and half-Speed standing; the creature stands automatically at the start of its turn (and for free when combat ends) instead of choosing to, and stays prone with 0 Speed; BG3-style, a prone creature also cannot take reactions (no opportunity attacks); crawling is deferred.
Applied by the data-defined Sap mastery and consumed by the affected creature's next resolved attack.

Applied by the data-defined Vex mastery and consumed by the source's next resolved attack against that target.
